resources.string: Makes long-press Home (3-button nav) or the corner-swipe (gesture nav) open the panel, exactly like Gemini. Needs no accessibility service.
Role dialog unavailable — set it in Default apps settings

Flick up or down along the MIDDLE of the left or right screen edge (not the bottom corner — that is the Home gesture). Needs the display-over-apps permission; runs persistently and restarts at boot. Turn it off here if you prefer assistant-only triggering.
Pick a preset or choose Custom and paste any OpenAI-compatible base URL (Groq, Together, Cerebras, local Ollama or LM Studio…) or a Gemini endpoint. The key is stored encrypted on this device.
Provider not configured — text copied to clipboard
Optional trigger: detects edge swipes (Android 14+) and observes the Home key. The main trigger is the Default Assistant role. This service never consumes your gestures.
Swipe in from a screen edge to summon AI.
